reviews.title: Decent flights Internationally, Domestic just alright
reviews.text: Flew Westjet on June 6/23 from home to Calgary then to London, UK; then on the way back on June 16/23, from Dublin to Calgary then home. When I booked with Westjet I used this company because my agent found the price was the cheapest of all the airlines which was great considering prices of so many things rising in cost, their price was even better than I have ever paid pre-Covid which I was super happy to see. The flights were nice and mostly comfortable with the exception of the flights from home to Calgary and back the seats were small, the flight from Calgary to London then Dublin to Calgary was very nice because the seats were fairly comfortable with a bit more room and 2 meals and 2 times for drink rounds during the flights. The service was great from the flight attendants as well and the choice for movies and other entertainment was decent so there was no way to be bored. Overall, I enjoyed the flights going to Europe and when I start planning my next trip to Europe in early 2024, I hope that Westjet will keep their flight prices lower in 2024 than the competition because I am willing to take them again in the future if they are cheapest. 4 of 5 for nice planes 4 of 5 for quality seats on International flights 4 of 5 for variety of entertainment 4.5 overall of everything
reviews.author: James M

reviews.title: The Worst!
reviews.text: I booked this 7/31/2023 flight back in March. It is a code share flight with Delta. At the time of booking, I secured seats 4A and 4B for my husband and myself. This was a 50th anniversary trip and I wanted it to be special. 4A and 4B have extra legroom for my very tall husband. I was unable to check in for the flight online and faced a long line at the airport. When I finally did check in, I was handed boarding passes for row 29, at the rear of the plane. The seats I carefully chose were taken away without explanation and I ended up in an uncomfortable seat in back better suited to a sardine than a human being. This is the ultimate cattle car, and the flight was almost two hours delayed as well. Do yourself a favor. If you must travel somewhere WestJet flies, find another carrier or just walk. You’ll be better off.
reviews.author: tkttoride

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: Both my flights were delayed for over an hour. Did not check baggage because this airline has lost my luggage in the past. Upon boarding the plane I was forced to check my carry on because there was “no more room.” The flight attendants did not apologize or make any effort to shift things around or make room. My bag had fragile items that were damaged and checking my baggage made me late for my pick up at my destination. The staff were unconcerned and did not try to help at all. Westjet used to be a good airline but no longer. I will be canceling my west jet elite Mastercard and flying with air Canada and porter from now on. What a terrible experience.
reviews.author: Michele M

reviews.title: "Have a great day"
reviews.text: We had traveled with Norwegian from Oslo to London and WestJet from London to Calgary and were ready for the last leg. Calgary to Victoria international airport. We had booked our tickets for a departure at 16:25, but they had changed it to 18:50, making our trip last not 18,5 hours, but nearly 21 hours! I asked if they could change it back to the original time, and the supervisor told me that there were plenty of seats available on a flight 3 hours earlier, but since the change they had made to our tickets was minor (i.e., less than three hours) - she could not change it. She did not try to find any way to help me but was eager to tell me that the cheap ticket I had bought gave no flexibility - But WestJet could change my ticket, making my trip three hours longer - without asking me. They were unwilling to help, although they had plenty of seats on earlier flights. They were inflexible, and the supervisor was just eager to tell me to "have a great day." So, I sat there at the airport for three extra hours, and my trip from Oslo to Victoria lasted more than 21 hours. With WestJet, it is difficult to have a great day.
reviews.author: John Green

reviews.title: Covering Blunders by dirty tricks
reviews.text: West Jet Lost our two bags and were finally delivered after 38 hours, when applied for inconvenience as mentioned in their baggage lost policy we were told we can only reimburse the amount what you bought things which were in your bags if you didn't buy any thing then there is nothing we offer. There is no inconvenience since you didn't replace ( by buying new ones ) your belongings - which were in your luggage - By this reply West jet was trying to tell us loosing bags is a right of West jet .. and We don't care about Passengers Inconvenience.. What a Shame ....
reviews.author: SAM C

reviews.title: worst experience of my life
reviews.text: Our flight from YOW to YYZ was delayed by an hour which ultimately led myself and 21 others to miss their connecting flight. They were so unhelpful, gave no accommodations or compensations for any new charges we had to make (hotel for a night in toronto which was sold out everywhere besides $600+ rooms). They could not connect us to our destination until 3 days from now which would be the day before we have flight tickets to depart. Just all around awful customer service, will never be flying with them again.
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.title: Horrible Service
reviews.text: We took a flight from IAH to YYC on June 17,2023. The ground staff was excellent but air cabin crew needs to learn about customer service. They were eager to sell Menu Items but served only water throughout the flight. Yes, only water two times no soda no coffee nothing else complimentary services. The flight was packed and fare was high but service they forgot. Since Pandemic and high fuel prices the number of flights are reduced and airfare sky rocketed. Now the fuel prices went down drastically and we all got rid of Covid but the attitude towards service is same. I wonder is it me or?
reviews.author: Waqar K

reviews.title: Great service and comfortable flight
reviews.text: Very nice airline! Good media to keep me occupied for 8 1/2 hours. More food than I could consume in that time frame! Wonderful service from the flight staff. We had multiple offers of snacks and beverages, as well as a delicious meal. Our seats were roomy, even in economy. I would fly this airline again in a heartbeat!
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: Fast flight across Europe, staff was nice, no problems. Better then the discount carriers of Europe in every way.
reviews.author: robjustrob

reviews.title: Quick and easy
reviews.text: Flight went on time, landed early, no problems at all. The in flight food was terrible, not just bad, but terrible. They need to fire whomever is in charge of the menu.
reviews.author: robjustrob

reviews.title: WestJet Slays
reviews.text: They will do all they can to get you on your flight, not flying with anyone else after my nightmare with Flair Airlines!
reviews.author: Shelby S

reviews.title: Left stranded.
reviews.text: I travel with a service dog quite often. We chose to travel with westJet to visit my sick mother in northern Quebec. When we arrived at the airport, the booth issued a ticket to my wife but not to me. I was told to wait in line to get a ticket issued. 50 minutes later, i got to a ticket booth and was told that I had missed my flight since they close the ticket issuance 1hr before flight departure. They then offered to leave three days later or pay a fee and go to Montreal. They made us miss our flight and got us 7 hours away from our final destination during the Montreal grand prix... We incured huge costs. Do yourself a favor and fly with another airline if you have a service dog.
reviews.author: jonathan m

reviews.title: Good Flights
reviews.text: Booked Westjet for my holiday as the originally operated London - Vancouver direct, but they withdrew from the route booking us via Calgary instead. I was initially concerned by this because of the extra hassle of connecting, but I need not have worried as the flights were on time and the connection at Calgary very simple, with helpful staff on hand to assist. International legs of the flights were excellent,the crew were attentive, comfortable seating, good in flight entertainment and food was reasonable. The Canada domestic leg was short flight around 1 hour, but included refreshments and a snack which is better than you get on most European carriers.
reviews.author: Colin

reviews.title: If you can't eat gluten, bring your own food.
reviews.text: With about 10% of the population either celiac or intolerant to gluten, you would think that an airline like Westjet would take that into consideration. I have flown Westjet many times. The past few times, I have flown Premium Economy. When I mentioned that I can't eat gluten the flight attendant said she'd see what she could do. She came back with some jerky and some soft cheese and breadsticks (which had gluten). Another time, a flight attendant brought me a small tray full of snacks - chips, jerky, hummus etc. It is not a very nice feeling munching on a hunk of jerky when the person next to you is enjoying a lovely, hot, great smelling meal. So, pack your own snacks if you can't eat gluten, even if you are paying bigger bucks for Premium. (Oh and make sure that your snacks don't contain peanuts because if there is someone on board with a peanut allergy you will not even be allowed to open your snacks.) The lack of gluten free options is both disappointing and discriminatory.
reviews.author: sunflash

reviews.title: poor customer/front desk service, unwilling to help out passengers, misuse of power and poorly maintained flights
reviews.text: we have traveled quite a lot with different airlines, this is our first travel with WestJet (chosen because this was the only direct flight from YYC-JFK) and I am not impressed at all. the check in counter is poorly staffed with customers waiting in long lines, and staff unwilling to help/unaware of international passports/permanent residence card checks/ rude and misusing their position of "perceived power"/. asking me to pay for my check in baggage when my booking clearly stated 1 free bag check in per passenger. I almost missed my flight due to delays in check in process with poor staffing, the flight itself is old, with no in flight entertainment whatsoever, wi fi not working, no tv or magazines for a 4 hour flight. poor choices of food. definitely not taking again and not recommended
reviews.author: Chipz

reviews.title: Useless airline, terrible customer service
reviews.text: Day of my flight it was cancelled. Booked on new flight, delayed then delayed again. Waited hours in the customer service line. Unhelpful btchy customer service rep said there would be no remedy. “Out of our control”, sorry.
reviews.author: JD

reviews.title: Westjet Las Vegas employees are literally the worst.
reviews.text: I had a bunch of WJ credit to use or lose so I’ve flown a few times this month. They are extremely rude and unprofessional. They do not care about anything or anyone. Yesterday I arrived an hour before my flight to check my bag because it takes literally 3 minutes to get through security. There was NO ONE there. Not one person. I could have easily made my flight. I sat there for and watched my flight take off and still no one showed up. It’s ridiculous. Today I showed up and they told me my carryon was too big. It’s the carryon size I use on every airline. Their carryon dimensions are smaller than the other airlines (probably so they can charge you more. Joke’s on them because I’m Delta Diamond and don’t have to pay for bags). The lady at the bay counter had a heavy Asian accent. When I told her I didn’t understand what she was saying (low talker as well) she got mad and yelled at me. I have had better experiences with Allegiant and Frontier which are the worst. As soon as I use my remaining credit after this month, never ever again will I fly with WestJet.
reviews.author: DiamondDave

reviews.title: Very poor unhelpful service
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible customer service 0 rating. Got delayed in Austin; missed our flight to Kelowna in Calgary. Left stranded without our bags with NO accommodations or consideration. Unhelpful staff throughout the airport.
reviews.author: Doug M

reviews.title: No service
reviews.text: Upon arrival at PUJ the representative who is meant to arrange bus was rude and too busy chatting with a bunch of friends to pay attention . Finally got in bus long long trip . West Jet could have easily separated our group and rented smaller vans. We had young children hungry and thirsty taking a 2 hour bus ride to resort . Also this resort Grand Sirenis is NOT in Punta Cana it's in Higuey. West Jet need to provide actual location and not give broad directions. No representatives of West Jet on resort . It took a total of 12 hours of travel . 7 days all inclusive isn't really 7 days .
reviews.author: Sengenya

reviews.title: rude flight attendant.
reviews.text: I flew from Cancun to Calgary on June 10th, we had a 6:30pm flight which was delayed about an hour everyone was pretty annoyed because we were trying to get home but nothing you can do about that. My issue was with the one flight attendant on board, her name was Stephanie and her attitude was something I’d never seen. She yelled at my boyfriend when he tried to open an overhead bin “If it’s closed it is full you need to find another one” We were one of the first on the flight & in the last row, this overhead bin was FULL of the flight attendant’s belongings before anyone boarded which we hadn’t seen before on flights that is why he attempted to open. Then another lady did the same thing trying to open an overhead bin and the attendant proceeded to speak very rudely to her telling her to keep moving along it was full, the lady trying to stow her bag didn’t have good english and they way the flight attendant spoke to her was ridiculous only because she didn’t understand her. I tried to let it go but during take off she proceeded to snap at people for asking questions and rolling her eyes even during the safety instructions she avoided eye contact and no smile, rolling her eyes at anyone she did make eye contact with. She rammed my boyfriends arm multiple times walking by him ( he was not in the aisle she just wasn’t being aware of her body position ) and also said to him “why couldn’t you” with the most judgmental face when he asked if he could use the bathroom before take off
reviews.author: tana a

reviews.title: deplorable customer service
reviews.text: WestJet cancelled our flight at the last hour due to their labour dispute/strike leaving us stranded without a hotel at 11pm at night. The gentleman promised to cover our hotel when I spoke to them on the phone. I submitted the receipt only to be told 3 weeks later they will not cover it because they are filing the strike as “out of their control.” I had to purchase a different flight (at a much higher price), pay the hotel, food, and miss a day of wages and they are taking zero responsibility for even the hotel. Really concerning for a large airline with a wide customer base. Will not be flying again with West Jet.
reviews.author: Anne Nelson

reviews.title: No problems! Had a great flight!
reviews.text: Westjet has always been my choice and this trip went without any hassles. Planes were mostly on time. Only one delay that lasted 30 minutes. The planes were clean. The price was okay. All flights seem to be very expensive right now, but it was a better price than Air Canada when I bought the tickets. It also had better flight schedules. I will continue to use WestJet when I fly.
reviews.author: Thradia

reviews.title: Couldn’t make it to our flight due to natural disaster and had to reschedule our flight
reviews.text: We came out to Vancouver island for just over a week and this morning on our way back across the island, we came across a forest fire that will have the main highway and only highway closed for days which made us miss our flight, upon rescheduling our flight west jet charged us 709$ extra to do so. Don’t get me wrong missing your flight is one thing but missing it due to a circumstance like this is just wrong and to make money off people that way, this is 100% the last time i will ever deal with them.
reviews.author: austin a

reviews.title: I had to have a wheel chair
reviews.text: I just had surgery and had to have a wheel chair, Montreal was awesome they were so much help, and the flight crew were very nice and professional, but when I got to Calgary I waited on the plane for the wheel chair but never showed and I was worried I would miss my connecting flight, so I started walking in really bad pain off the airplane down the gangway and inside then ask for a wheel chair then the two ladies would stop talking and said o ya, then they wheeled me to my next flight and then they said you can walk to the plane, and then took off with the wheel chair, so I had no choice to walk to the airplane, then the flight crew were very unprofessional from Calgary to Abbotsford, and again no wheel chair, and that was a very long walk to get inside, after that my recovery was Impacted big time, I would never fly into Abbotsford again
reviews.author: Emily H

reviews.title: A positive experience
reviews.text: Reviews of this airline seem either to be positive or very negative, with nothing around 'average'. Happily we are in the positive camp. Premium Economy was very comfortable with silver service, reminiscent of biz class a couple of decades ago. The only minor negative was a limited entertainment offering. The crew were particularly friendly. We flew back biz class, at a very keen price. Food and drink not up to European airline standards, maybe, but seat ( lie flat bed) comfort and service were top notch. Punctuality was ace, landing on schedule to the minute. It may be that Westjet is trustworthy on its premium international routes, where is uses fairly new Dreamliners, while most of the negative reviews relate to domestic routes with older,smaller equipment.
reviews.author: Simon C

reviews.title: Unprofessional
reviews.text: Completely unprofessional attitude and behaviour JEAN- LOIS ALLARD (flight attendant from Vancouver to Edmonton, 2022). I will never fly with west Jet again.
reviews.author: apple91

reviews.title: Excellent Service on Flight and Good Post Flight Pilferage.
reviews.text: While flying back to Toronto from Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, I was exceptionally impressed to the point of precipitating this most positive review. Although I later learned that my $3200 CAD camera set was pilfered from my luggage, I still found it necessary to honor flight crew of Flight 2767 PUJ-YYZ Daniel Talitha and Marjorie Yeison for their second-to-none service. Even without Premium Economy I got served the same if not at least felt like it. Irrespective of the unwelcomed stress of delays and turbulence--these two flight attendants pacified me to the point of perfection with complementary drinks and speedy service. That said, although I was later disappointed to learn that my stuff was stolen--and I have started a claim with WestJet HDQWS24550--I am still satisfied enough with this airline to write this review. Hopefully my family and I will have a follow up testimonial once my case is resolved and we are compensated for our loss.
reviews.author: Jai Jind

reviews.title: Would give a rating of 0 if I could
reviews.text: Would give 0 stars if I could. This is the worst airline I have ever been on. It has the smallest seats but honestly I can deal with that, the main problem is as follows: They delayed my whole vacation by 8 hours saying I couldn’t make my second flight even tho the first came in, in time as the second was still at the airport and loading passengers. Then they lost my luggage and never sent it on the new flight with significant layover that they forced us on. They caused $400 extra dollars to my trip because I had to pay for a different transfer, paid for a hotel day we never got to use, and had to buy clothes and toiletries to wear and use for the first 2.5 days of our trip. We also had to pay for extra meals and our 14 hour travel day turned to 21 hours. They also determined in the claim that they owed nothing, twice. I’ve never experienced such terrible communication and negligence from an airline and would never EVER take them again and would strongly advise that the public STEER CLEAR of this airline. My trip vastly changed and we suffered due to this negligence. We are not wealthy people. This $$ was a big deal to us, and WestJet had nothing to say or offer. No voucher. No customer service. They screwed 15 passengers in our flight from SFO to Rome. DID NOT CARE. Sent us on a 3 flight trip instead of a 2 flight trip. I hope they go out of business as they do not know how to run one.
reviews.author: Luvbug T

reviews.title: WestJet lied, forced us to relocate to an unsafe and dangerous hotel. Scammed for almost $500 on top of a $3500 trip.
reviews.text: WestJet canceled our return flight last minute. Then immediately forced us to leave our current hotel. We were then taken to a hotel where a couple we spoke to had just got food poisoning after a single night stay at this hotel. The rooms were filthy and the safes did not work, thus resulting in a health and safety situation that was quite dangerous. We could’ve gotten sick from food poisoning, sick from the filthy room and/or had our passports, money and other valuables stolen. WestJet told our hotel rep to lie to all of us and say “there are no rooms available” to which the same rep admitted this was not true. We basically got scammed and were forced to pay almost $500 just to get taken back to the safety of our original hotel, of which all of a sudden had an available room, only minutes after WestJet lied and said the hotel had no available rooms. The WestJet pilot the following day explained that it was a scheduling error caused by WestJet which was the cause of the cancelled flight, which, according to WestJet’s own policy, this would be considered reasonable for a compensation claim. Unsurprisingly at this point, WestJet then immediately rejected our claim for any compensation, and closed the communication line. I am completely astounded at how WestJet treats its member and I just hope to anybody considering flying with WestJet, that 1) Pray your flight doesn’t get cancelled, and 2) If it does, be prepared to be scammed, lied to, and/or taken to an unhealthy and dangero
reviews.author: Connor H

reviews.title: Seat issue
reviews.text: My partner and I travelled from Melbourne, Australia to Vancouver….then a connecting flight with WestJet to Toronto. We always checked in together and everything was going well until we took our seats, only to be told that we would be moved to other seats as ours were allocated for the Hostesses. Why put us in these seats in the first place? Then to make things worse, we were put in different seats so we weren’t even sitting together. There were seats available to be together. We didn’t say anything because we didn’t want to cause a scene. This is not only unacceptable but ridiculous and unprofessional to say the least.
reviews.author: Brenda D
